Messages.Author: Herve Guillemet
Messages.Body:
Short question that must already have been dealt with:

Can Obedience be used by a tapped vampire. ?
This situation can occur when a tapped vampire is the target of a
Bum's Rush.
In other words, does the sentence "Can only be used in combat" supersedes
the general rule "Tapped vampire cannot play reaction cards" ?
I believe not. Could someone confirm ?

== Herve Guillemet

Messages.Author: Zach Haffey
Messages.Body:



Yes, obedience is can be used in a sitch where the reacting vampire is
tapped, but it doesn't untap you.

-Zach

Messages.Author: Joe Helfrich
Messages.Body:
Herve Guillemet (guil...@marsouin.imed.jussieu.fr) wrote:
: Short question that must already have been dealt with:
:
: Can Obedience be used by a tapped vampire. ?
: This situation can occur when a tapped vampire is the target of a
: Bum's Rush.

Hurm. Obedience says to use as entering combat with an acting vampire.
Since this usually happes due to a block, the vamp playing obedience
should already be tapped. Hence, I don't see any trouble with using it in
the situation you described.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
guil...@marsouin.imed.jussieu.fr (Herve Guillemet) writes:

>Short question that must already have been dealt with:

>Can Obedience be used by a tapped vampire. ?
>This situation can occur when a tapped vampire is the target of a
>Bum's Rush.
>In other words, does the sentence "Can only be used in combat" supersedes
>the general rule "Tapped vampire cannot play reaction cards" ?
>I believe not. Could someone confirm ?

True, it does not. Only untapped vampires may play reaction cards.
The restrictions are cumulative:
Only untapped vampires about to enter combat with younger acting
vampires can play Obedience.
